# anthropic_federation_rules (Data Source)

Lists workload identity federation rules. Requires `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_federation_rules" "github_actions" {
  issuer_id = "fdis_01ExampleIssuerId00000000"
}

output "rule_names" {
  value = data.anthropic_federation_rules.github_actions.rules[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include archived rules. Defaults to `false`.
- `issuer_id` (String) Only return rules for this issuer.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `applies_to_all_workspaces` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled for every workspace.
- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Rule id.
- `issuer_id` (String) Issuer id.
- `name` (String) Slug name.
- `oauth_scope` (String) Scope of minted tokens.
- `service_account_id` (String) Target service account id.
- `token_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Lifetime of minted tokens.
- `workspace_ids` (List of String) Workspaces the rule is enabled for.
